Classical SARIMA(1,0,1)(1,0,1)[12] outperforms modern models by 2.5% RMSE due to stable autoregressive/seasonal memory without overfitting.
Exogenous meteorological covariates and non-linear interactions provide competitive advantage over purely univariate models.
